summary: The retrieved content primarily focuses on handling and processing term release dates within a software system. It involves defining methods to generate a list of term dates based on certain conditions, utilizing a session object, and accommodating varying provincial release date options.
purpose: To manage the calculation and handling of release dates for academic terms based on predefined rules and configurations.

workflows.name: Calculate Term Release Dates
steps: Initialize a Term object with the provided start date.
Create lists to hold release dates.
Call DateLists to populate the release date lists.
Depending on the term start date and provincial options, populate the release lists.

business_rules: If the start date is between January 1 and April 30, certain release dates are assigned based on the provincial option.
Different release dates are assigned if the term start date falls between May 1 and August 9.
conditions: StartDate >= new DateTime(Year, 1, 1) && StartDate <= new DateTime(Year, 4, 30)
StartDate >= new DateTime(Year, 5, 1) && StartDate <= new DateTime(Year, 8, 9)
system_behavior: The system builds three lists of release dates corresponding to different terms.
Lists are populated based on the configuration of the ProvincialReleaseDateOption.
